# last-price-investment-valuation: tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync.mjs from the live tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool below is on the Last Price MCP server (`https://api.last-price.ai/api/mcp/rpc`).
A tool missing from your own `tools/list` is not switched on for your connection yet.

## `value_investment`

Value a venture round the way an investor does: pass stage (pre_seed, seed, series_a, series_b, series_c or growth) and what you know, such as sector, currency, round_size, traction (arr or mrr, revenue_growth_yoy_pct, gross_margin_pct, net_revenue_retention_pct, monthly_burn, months_of_runway), team, market, comps (comparable rounds, at most 25) and the offer on the table (pre_money with investment, or post_money). It answers a fair post-money range (low, mid, high), the pre-money and ownership the round implies, each method it could run (stage benchmark with a scorecard, revenue multiple, comparable rounds, VC method, round dilution) with the inputs it used and a note, the methods it skipped and why, a verdict on the offer (cheap, fair or rich), confidence, signals and the assumptions it made. Deterministic rules of thumb for US and European rounds in US dollars, applied as they are to EUR and GBP; no model call, nothing stored. Public: needs no credential, limited per address.

- **Access:** none needed (keyless)
- **Behaviour:** read only

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `stage` | string | The round being priced. Required. |
| `company_name` | string | The company, for the answer. |
| `sector` | string | The sector; sets heat and the exit multiple. |
| `currency` | string | The currency of every amount. Defaults to USD. |
| `round_size` | number | How much the round raises. |
| `traction` | object | arr, mrr, revenue_growth_yoy_pct, gross_margin_pct, net_revenue_retention_pct, customers, monthly_active_users, monthly_burn, months_of_runway. |
| `team` | object | founders, repeat_founder, prior_exit, domain_experts. |
| `market` | object | tam, competition (few, some or many). |
| `comps` | array | Comparable rounds you know. Each needs post_money, or pre_money with round_size; add arr for a revenue multiple. |
| `offer` | object | The deal on the table: post_money, or pre_money with investment. |
| `years_to_exit` | number | Years to the exit the VC method projects. Defaults by stage. |
| `exit_multiple` | number | EV/revenue at exit. Defaults by sector. |
| `target_return_multiple` | number | The multiple the investor underwrites to. Defaults by stage. |
